title: ICS advisory correlation (no exploitation)
description: Map observed products/versions/protocols to vendor/CISA advisories.
detail: Use observed banners/identity (s7-info, enip-info, modbus-discover, http headers, etc.) — no exploitation. 1) Extract vendor/product/model/version/firmware from read-identify evidence. 2) Correlate to vendor advisories and CISA ICS Advisories (ICS-CERT) by product/version. 3) Confirm applicability to the *exposed path* (advisory-to-banner alone = inventory; becomes a finding when the path/condition exists in scope). 4) Prioritize by exposure + impact; recommend patching/compensating controls/segmentation. Record as vuln/informational facts with evidence refs.
